thesis_invalidators.invalidating_print: A 2026-10-30 Q3 print or guide that cuts production outlook or shows refining margins collapsing enough to force consensus FY26/FY27 EPS cuts of more than 5%.
thesis_invalidators.invalidating_structure: A daily close below $208 on rising volume, giving back the breakout shelf while SPY remains above its 200-DMA (stock-specific failure).
thesis_invalidators.time_box: Exit by the 2026-10-29 close in every case so we are not holding through the 2026-10-30 binary; if CVX has not held a daily close above $225 by 2026-10-24, cut or exit.
